waveform_checks.scope: Representative cells/directions, exact two actual carrier phasors only

directional_search.method: Exact original 26 lattice directions plus 2048 Fibonacci directions, original order
directional_search.metric: max_sampled_real_unit_u 2 min(abs(E2000 dot u),abs(E2010 dot u))
directional_search.angular_maximum_scope: Sampled lower bound; not continuum angular maximum

coordinate_system.weighting: Caller-passed original fractional native ROI weights in m3; stable inverse volume ECDF

conventions.current: Derived gamma*E total current including displacement; not independent validation
conventions.modulation: Two actual distinct sinusoidal carriers only; no multi-frequency extrapolation

thresholds.high_modulation_volume: not_run; no preregistered numerical cutoffs in this provisional batch

symmetry.transform: x -> -x; pad permutation0<->2,1<->3; negate both source solutions to retain positive differential source convention
symmetry.physical_inference: For the isotropic layered cylinder and floating differential pairs, reflected and sign-reversed solutions satisfy the corresponding G6 equations. This is not valid for a physical common-ground constraint and does not equate the published common-ground baselines.
symmetry.angular_caveat: The fixed2074real-direction sample is not exactly reflection closed; recompute transformed-field metrics to measure orientation sampling sensitivity. Not a new independent geometry solve or proof of full angular/mesh convergence.

preregistration.method: ExactXYreflection permutation and common sign reversal of both fields; rerun same2074direction metric to quantify angular-sampling covariance defect
